scope: CSAgent PU scorer provenance and validation protocol

CGCNN-PU OOB.model_architecture: CrystalGraphConvNet: atom_fea_len=64, n_conv=3, h_fea_len=128, n_h=1, classification=True

training_and_selection_evidence.meaning: validation ROC-AUC is evaluated every epoch and best checkpoint is saved

MatterSim-1M-MLP-PU OOB.model_architecture: Frozen MatterSim-v1.0.0-1M embedding (128 dimensions) + MLP head 128-256-256-2 with SiLU, Dropout and LogSoftmax

training_and_selection_evidence.meaning: same bag train/valid rows; best head selected by validation ROC-AUC

scoring_evidence.meaning: same bag-membership OOB mask writes clscore_b_all.csv

semantics.zero_label: unlabeled candidate sampled as pseudo-negative for that bag

full_pool_output_coverage.reason: MatterSim preprocessing filters malformed/unsupported geometries; missing IDs are not negative labels
full_pool_output_coverage.comparison_rule: intersect IDs before paired A/B analysis

aggregation_guidance.raw_mean_A_B: not scientifically justified as a calibrated probability without paired calibration
aggregation_guidance.statistical_note: A and B share the same PU labels and bag splits; architectural diversity does not make the validation observations statistically independent
aggregation_guidance.recommended: report A and B separately; use low-tail intersection or calibrated/rank-normalized aggregation
